scope: Two 146-chunk episodes per probe; real model/GPU/Ray/FSDP with dummy UR. Temporary process-local wrappers. Measurements are host elapsed; nested waits must not be added twice.

conclusions.first_action: The hardware-free probe directly attributes about 0.37 seconds to two sequential lazy communication-group initializations on the Rollout -> Env channel -> Env path. Original 1.43 seconds lies outside local effective work on this path, but per-group original durations were not logged.
conclusions.first_commit: Lazy episode-transfer/ACK channels and original 1-second learner polling produce first-episode startup delays. Buffer insertion itself was about 11ms in both probes. The complete original 6.56-7.56 second tail was not reproduced; exact original attribution remains unresolved.
conclusions.env_residual: Real-run 8.718ms is action_execution_ms minus command_ms/pace_wait_ms/observation_ms, averaged over the same 1060 complete chunks. It includes unsegmented work around UR5eEnv.step: keyboard/teleop context, observation copies/transforms, vector concatenation/deepcopy, RealWorldEnv wrapping/metrics, timing record emission, and chunk aggregation. No component-wise allocation of this residual is measured.
